closedFindings.finding: Immediate signal/watchdog exit bypassed normal temporary clipboard restoration
closedFindings.resolution: Tracked native pending transaction, cooperative signal unwind, bounded watchdog restoration and explicit unconfirmed metadata

closedFindings.finding: LaunchServices completion did not validate actual bundle path or new-instance argument identity
closedFindings.resolution: Compares resolved bundle identity, forces new instances for arguments, rejects prior process identities and returns actualURL

closedFindings.finding: Blanket high-layer CG exclusion could admit input intercepted by an AX-hidden floating panel
closedFindings.resolution: Uses public NSWindow windowNumberAtPoint:belowWindowWithWindowNumber:0 for actual mouseDown receiver, followed by exact AX window hit confirmation
closedFindings.apiContract: AppKit NSWindow.h documents the frontmost window that would be hit by a mouseDown, across applications; available since macOS10.6

closedFindings.finding: A delayed main thread could admit a temporary clipboard write after watchdog stop
closedFindings.resolution: BOOL TrackClipboard checks stopping atomically under the same eventLock before transaction admission; active transaction remains retained until the write finishes

closedFindings.finding: GCD main-queue frame execution prevented nested run-loop waits from servicing LaunchServices callbacks
closedFindings.resolution: CFRunLoopPerformBlock plus wakeup dispatches a single frame while the reader waits on its semaphore, with the existing per-frame deadline

closedFindings.finding: When the App exits but an observed service/ACC/helper identity remains, the normal absence assertion times out, yet finally only terminates the App, launcher and receiver. The recorded ownedTree remnants are not reclaimed.
closedFindings.requiredResolution: Recheck recorded PID/creation identities, terminate only those owned survivors, and await their exits before deleting the isolated data root.
closedFindings.resolution: Collects App/service/ACC/helper creation identities from the native report PID, independently reaps all remaining recorded identities on the final path, and retains isolation evidence on failure.
closedFindings.negativeEvidenceNote: The forced failure is intentional and retained as a failure. Its cleanup/restoration assertions are the relevant proof; it is not counted as a successful functional run.

closedFindings.finding: An early watchdog-test failure invokes killOwnTree(watchdogWorker) then immediately allows the fixture to restore/exit, without awaiting worker exit and refreshing the controlled clipboard version. Worker recovery can race fixture restoration or leave its final owned version unobserved.
closedFindings.requiredResolution: Boundedly stop and await the watchdog worker, observe/track the current controlled clipboard after termination, then terminate the restoring fixture. Preserve this ordering on failure.
closedFindings.resolution: Stops the watchdog writer and awaits actual exit, preserving the original fixture snapshot through a failed initial cleanup wait, then refreshes clipboard ownership before fixture termination.
closedFindings.negativeEvidenceNote: The forced failure is intentional and retained as a failure. Its cleanup/restoration assertions are the relevant proof; it is not counted as a successful functional run.

closedFindings.finding: textIdentity is only set after a title-matched CG window is observed. If a new TextEdit launches but window observation fails, final cleanup kills the open waiter while stopTextEdit returns without a recorded identity, leaving the launched instance unowned.
closedFindings.requiredResolution: Record new TextEdit process creation identity and actual executable association as soon as it starts, independently of successful window/title observation, then clean only those verified identities on every final path.
closedFindings.resolution: Registers exact TextEdit executable invocation with a unique fixture-root argument and process birth identity before observing its CG window. The final path reaps every early-registered identity.
closedFindings.negativeEvidenceNote: Pre-observation injected failure remains exactly one expected FAIL. Cleanup passes; this is not counted as a successful functional run.

closedFindings.finding: Final readiness barrier could return an unmarked failure after an explicit clipboard write had already changed system state
closedFindings.resolution: RuyiAutomationWriteClipboard successful writes uniformly mark acted/action_sent. The final lock/authorization barrier can return outcome unconfirmed for both text and image writes.
closedFindings.verification: Reviewed latest source and added assertions. Frozen-candidate execution remains pending.

closedFindings.finding: New Mac selected-app CDP-only browser fixture did not satisfy the existing Windows-oriented browser cleanup static predicates
closedFindings.resolution: Registers browser and descendant birth identities, verifies all recorded identities have exited before deleting its profile, retains isolation on cleanup failure. Adds a narrow Mac static contract and refuses the CDP-only exception if startBrowserFixture is called. Existing Windows predicates remain.

testIncident.impact: The initial failed controlled-stop test cleaned the MCP subtree before its pending paste completed. The exited fixture memory could not restore the original clipboard. No original clipboard content was logged.
testIncident.followup: The test now awaits pending input completion and observes restoration before cleanup. Subsequent main-agent runs report original-snapshot restoration. The historical loss is retained as an incident, not marked recovered.
